_comment: The widget types LaunchPad renders itself, keyed by the `widgetId` a placement carries.
the frontend widgetRegistry's keys EQUAL this list, and DemoShowcasesService::partitionWidgets()
keeps a showcase widget whose type is on it. Before this file the PHP side knew only tiles and
Nextcloud dashboard ids, so the case-handler showcase installed with none of its four widgets.
Add or remove a type in the registry and here in the same commit; the vitest names the drift.
